extracted.name: Pineapple Cream Cheese Frosting
extracted.description: Try this pineapple-flavored frosting on lemon cake or lemon cookies.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, room temperature
instruction_lines: Beat butter and cream cheese in a large bowl with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Beat in pineapple juice until fully absorbed. Gradually beat in confectioners' sugar until fully incorporated.
